verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm offering attorney-led legal services, not a software product. User-configurable background automations are outside its product category. Its client portal only covers document upload, messaging, and case-status tracking, and its expiration tracking is a service performed by staff, not an automation a user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
